constellations.summary: The Dendro Archon links up to 8 enemies with Tri-Karma Purification, delivering massive off-field Dendro damage and team EM buffs.
Adds 1 extra count to each elemental type for the Shrine of Maya Burst buff.
Dendro core reactions (Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon) can critically strike (20% CR, 100% CD), and Quicken/Spread shred 30% enemy DEF.
Increases Nahida's EM by up to 160 based on linked enemies.
Attacking linked enemies after Burst deals up to 6 instances of 200% ATK + 400% EM AoE Dendro DMG.
